name: Airwright
tagline: The operating system for the modern HVAC field business.
positioning: Airwright unifies dispatch, service agreements, and invoicing into one disciplined workflow built for owner-operated heating and cooling companies.

hero.h1: Run a tighter HVAC shop, one dispatch at a time.
hero.sub: Airwright brings scheduling, technician routing, maintenance agreements, and same-day invoicing into a single system engineered for owner-operators who answer their own phones.

features.title: Dispatch board that holds up in July
features.description: Drag calls across your technician roster, see drive time before you commit, and rebook no-shows without touching a paper schedule.

features.title: Service agreements on autopilot
features.description: Airwright tracks every maintenance contract, triggers seasonal tune-up reminders, and flags the accounts due for renewal before they lapse.

features.title: Invoice from the driveway
features.description: Techs build line-item invoices on the truck, capture card payments on-site, and sync every transaction to your books the same afternoon.

features.title: Price books your crew can trust
features.description: Standardize flat-rate pricing across every technician so the quote a homeowner hears matches the invoice they sign.

features.title: Equipment history that follows the unit
features.description: Every system carries its full service record, warranty status, and photos, so the second visit starts where the first one ended.

features.title: Margin you can actually see
features.description: Job costing pulls labor, parts, and trip charges together so you know which work makes money and which quietly drains it.

testimonials.quote: We cut our unbilled work in half the first month. Every ticket now closes with a signed invoice before the tech leaves the property.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitcomb

testimonials.quote: Airwright made our maintenance agreements the backbone of the business. Renewals stopped slipping through the cracks the moment we switched.
testimonials.name: Marcus Petrelli

testimonials.quote: During the summer surge I can rebalance six trucks from my phone. It replaced the whiteboard, the group text, and three spreadsheets.
testimonials.name: Renata Voss

pricing.blurb: For solo shops and small crews getting off paper and spreadsheets.
For growing companies running multiple trucks and service agreements.
For multi-location operators standardizing across every branch.

homepage.footerBlurb: Airwright is the field service platform for owner-operated HVAC companies that take their reputation as seriously as their revenue.
